paper_title: Laboratory Constraints on the Neutron-Spin Coupling of feV-scale Axions
coupling_convention: g_aNN 95% limit (MC median lower envelope), dimensionless, in GeV^-1 as plotted
notes: Median 95% upper limit g_aNN < 2.4e-10 GeV^-1 for axion masses 0.4-4 feV (0.4 feV = 4e-16 eV... using stated range 0.4 to 4 feV => 4e-16 to 4e-15 eV). Note: this coupling is the dimensionful derivative coupling in GeV^-1, NOT the standard dimensionless g_an. The best median limit is 2.4e-10 GeV^-1 at 0.36 Hz. Full spectrum spans 0.01-10 Hz (~4e-17 to 4e-14 eV) with limits rising from ~2.4e-10 up to ~1e-6 GeV^-1. Mass range points: 0.4 feV = 1.65e-15 eV mislabeled; correct: 0.4 feV = 4e-16 eV, 4 feV = 4e-15 eV. Emitted a flat two-point line over the quoted 0.4-4 feV validity range. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.78, 41)) | Vision: Y-axis plotted in GeV^-1. Median limit 2.4e-10 GeV^-1 at 0.36 Hz confirmed in text. SN1987 line at ~1e-9 GeV^-1, neutron star line at ~1.2e-9 GeV^-1.
